verdict.rationale: Capacities offers AI Chats (with context from blocks/notes), AI property auto-fill, and an MCP server that lets external AI agents/chat apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) connect and interact with a space via natural language, giving genuine NL-driven operation paths. However, this is mostly content-assistance and external-agent integration rather than a native, in-app natural-language command interface for core operations (create/search/organize) — the evidence doesn't show broad NL command coverage beyond chat/property-fill/image-analysis features. Missing for 10: evidence of comprehensive in-app NL command execution for core actions, and independent hands-on validation of agentic command behavior.
